001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropMaskCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
017
018    private final SetVar set;
019    private final IntVar setCard;
020    private final IntVar maskedCard;
021    // Inclusive
022    private final int from;
023    // Exclusive
024    private final int to;
025
026    public PropMaskCard(SetVar set, IntVar setCard, SetVar masked, IntVar maskedCard, int from, int to) {
027        super(new Variable[]{set, setCard, maskedCard}, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
028
029        if (from > to) {
030            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
031        }
032
033        this.set = set;
034        this.setCard = setCard;
035        this.maskedCard = maskedCard;
036        this.from = from;
037        this.to = to;
038    }
039
040    @Override
041    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
042        int kerBetweenFromTo = 0;
043        ISetIterator setKer = set.getLB().iterator();
044        while (setKer.hasNext()) {
045            int i = setKer.nextInt();
046            if (i >= from && i < to) {
047                kerBetweenFromTo++;
048            }
049        }
050        int kerOutsizeFromTo = set.getLB().size() - kerBetweenFromTo;
051        int envBetweenFromTo = 0;
052        ISetIterator setEnv = set.getUB().iterator();
053        while (setEnv.hasNext()) {
054            int i = setEnv.nextInt();
055            if (i >= from && i < to) {
056                envBetweenFromTo++;
057            }
058        }
059        int envOutsizeFromTo = set.getUB().size() - envBetweenFromTo;
060        maskedCard.updateLowerBound(setCard.getLB() - envOutsizeFromTo, this);
061        maskedCard.updateUpperBound(setCard.getUB() - kerOutsizeFromTo, this);
062        setCard.updateLowerBound(maskedCard.getLB() + kerOutsizeFromTo, this);
063        setCard.updateUpperBound(maskedCard.getUB() + envOutsizeFromTo, this);
064
065        if (setCard.getLB() == maskedCard.getUB() + envOutsizeFromTo) {
066            setEnv.reset();
067            while (setEnv.hasNext()) {
068                int i = setEnv.nextInt();
069                if (i < from || i >= to) {
070                    set.force(i, this);
071                }
072            }
073        }
074        if (setCard.getUB() == maskedCard.getLB() + kerOutsizeFromTo) {
075            setEnv.reset();
076            while (setEnv.hasNext()) {
077                int i = setEnv.nextInt();
078                if (i < from || i >= to) {
079                    if (!set.getLB().contains(i)) {
080                        set.remove(i, this);
081                    }
082                }
083            }
084        }
085    }
086
087    @Override
088    public ESat isEntailed() {
089        return ESat.TRUE;
090    }
091}
